column2: Separate canvas per window
Each container window is drawn on its own canvas so a change in one window no longer redraws every open window. Applies to windows opened afterwards. Needed by Hide closed windows instantly.
Keep closed windows in place
A closed window stays in the floating-window layer instead of moving back so reopening it does not move its contents between canvases. Needed by Hide closed windows instantly.
Hide closed windows instantly
A closed container window simply stops being drawn instead of switching off everything inside it. Reopening a full window is then nearly instant. Works together with the two options above.
Open preset windows one by one
The storage-preset hotkey opens or closes its windows over a few frames (the first at once) so animations keep running.
Batch inventory layouts
Each inventory is re-laid out once per frame instead of once per item change. Speeds up loading and changes inside full containers.
Fast selection highlight
The highlight under selected items and the placement preview are updated in place instead of being redrawn every frame. Removes the stutter while a large selection is held or dragged.
Check items once while loading
While a save loads
column3: each item's look is worked out once per inventory instead of dozens of times as its tags are restored. Speeds up loading a large store. The loaded items are the same.

column2: Fast buyer check
Decides whether a customer will buy a container in one pass over its contents instead of rechecking every level. Customers accept and refuse exactly as before.
Log long frames
Writes frames over 100 ms to Player.log with the window opened just before. Costs nothing.
Profile long frames

Breaks every frame over 100 ms down in Player.log into script and engine time and UI rebuild and rendering and the slowest game methods. Slows the game slightly while on so leave it off for normal play.
